reason: The README identifies this as an OMP-style dsh terminal UI plugin focused on rendering, input interaction, themes, layouts, and session controls, with an additional WeChat bridge for remote commands and notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 提供 OMP 风格的终端界面、主题布局、输入交互、会话管理及可选的微信桥接功能。
summaries.en: Provides dsh with an OMP-style terminal interface, theme and layout controls, input interaction, session management, and an optional WeChat bridge.

capabilities: Provides a terminal user interface for dsh sessions
Supports session creation, naming, resumption, and switching
Allows model, reasoning, mode, permission, theme, and locale selection
Provides slash-command and path or file-reference completion
Connects dsh sessions to WeChat through the documented iLink bridge
Sends task progress and results to configured WeChat users
Stores session and WeChat bridge state locally
